# AssetForge

> AssetForge is a Windows desktop app (Electron + React + TypeScript) that turns a short text brief into game-ready assets for Unreal Engine 5. It chains AI services into a node-based pipeline: an LLM prompt engine (Claude or any OpenAI-compatible/local model), Meshy (text/image to 3D, textures, rigging), NVIDIA Kimodo (text to motion), ElevenLabs (sound effects, dynamic engine audio), ComfyUI (textures), Blender (cleanup, LODs) and Unreal Engine 5 Python Remote Execution (import). It also generates complete animation systems (Blend Space 1D/2D, Anim Montage, Aim Offset, jump state machine, Motion Matching with Pose Search) with seamless loops and sync markers, and exposes an MCP server so AI agents can drive the pipeline. License: GNU AGPL-3.0 (free and open source, including commercial use of the app and its outputs); a commercial license is available for closed-source use of the code. Current version: 0.4.5 alpha.
